aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer; the abstract contrasts localized with advanced incident prostate cancer.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: The reduced risk of prostate cancer associated with allium vegetables was independent of body size, intake of other foods, and total calorie intake and was more pronounced for men with localized than with advanced prostate cancer.
study_design: Population-based case-control study of incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We administered in-person interviews and collected information on 122 food items from 238 case subjects with incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer and from 471 male population control subjects.
reason: The abstract reports overall incident prostate cancer and a stage-specific comparison between localized and advanced prostate cancer. The 238 cases and 471 controls yield 709 analyzed participants. The garlic estimates are overall prostate cancer estimates, not advanced-disease estimates.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Similar comparisons between categories showed reductions in risk for men in the highest intake categories for garlic (OR = 0.47, 95% CI = 0.31 to 0.71; P(trend)<.001) and scallions (OR = 0.30, 95% CI = 0.18 to 0.51; P(trend)<.001).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate concerns prostate cancer overall. It is not identified as an estimate for advanced disease.
